certChanged: A different certificate is already stored for this server. Either it was renewed — or someone is posing as this server and listening in.
keyChanged: A different key is already stored for this host. Either the server was set up anew — or someone is posing as this server and listening in.
certUnknown: The system does not trust this server's certificate. Check the fingerprint before you trust it: exactly this certificate is remembered, only on this device — unlike "Don't verify certificate", which takes any.
hostUnknown: This host is not known yet. Check the fingerprint before you trust it: it is the only thing that protects the connection against an eavesdropper in the middle.
confirm: Sure? The server might be a different one.
